ideas.pitch: A high-speed autonomous line follower utilizing an array of 8 IR sensors and a custom PID control loop algorithm executed on an ESP32 for ultra-fast, overshoot-free cornering.
ideas.problem_statement: Design and build a fully autonomous line-following robot capable of navigating a predefined track featuring curves, sharp turns, intersections, and possible line gaps.
ideas.title: PID-Tuned Optic-Edge LFR
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates rigorous firmware engineering with a working PID controller, directly targeting the core metric of fastest completion time.

ideas.pitch: Combines a QTR-8RC analog reflectance sensor array with a low-cost Pixy/color camera module to reliably handle complex track intersections and sharp line gaps at high velocity.

ideas.title: Dual-Sensor Fusion Line Tracer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the notorious intersection and line-gap failure modes that trip up most basic analog or digital threshold-based robots.
